name: Isras Investment Company Ltd
summary: Isras Investment Company Ltd operates in the real estate sector in Israel. It engages in the residential and construction projects. The company also plans, constructs, and manages projects for rent, as well as acquires, develops, manages, and operates other properties, including a protected housing. The company was founded in 1950 and is based in Tel Aviv, Israel. Isras Investment Company Ltd is a subsidiary of Arad Investment & Industrial Development Ltd.
